description: Permanently delete a Gmail draft by its draft ID. This does not move the draft to Trash — it is removed immediately. Use gmail_send_draft to send a draft instead of deleting it.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

draft_id.description: The Gmail draft ID to delete

name: gws-mcp__gmail_delete_draft
